feeds.title: The Health Care Blog » Health Policy
feeds.description: The Health Care Blog is the leading online forum covering the business of healthcare and the new ideas that are changing the health care industry. Our readers are executives at healthcare networks and organizations, policymakers on the state and federal level, decision-makers, doctors and nurses, med students, investors and entrepreneurs and consumers trying to come to grips with the changes impacting the healthcare system. Everything you always wanted to know about the Health Care system. But were afraid to ask.

feeds.title: HealthPopuli
feeds.description: This blog, founded by health economist Jane Sarason-Kahn, is home to tons of in-depth analysis of healthcare policy and its effect on costs and outcomes.

feeds.title: Georgetown Center For Children and Families
feeds.description: The Georgetown University Center for Children and Families (CCF) is an independent, nonpartisan policy and research center founded in 2005 with a mission to support access to high-quality, comprehensive and affordable health coverage for all of America's children and families.

feeds.title: Gary's Newsletter
feeds.description: Click to read Gary's Newsletter, by Gary Levin, a Substack publication. Launched a year ago, Gary discusses current trends and issues in the Medical sector. Read his expert opinions and analyses on health policy here.

feeds.title: The Goodman Institute Health Blog
feeds.description: For many years, our health care blog was the only free enterprise health policy blog on the internet. Then, when the NCPA closed its doors, the health blog stopped as well. During this five-year hiatus, no one else has come forward to claim the space. So, my colleagues and I have decided to restart the blog in connection with the Goodman Institute. We invite you and others to use this forum to share your views.

feeds.title: Center For Health Law and Policy Innovation » Health Law & Policy
feeds.description: The Center for Health Law and Policy Innovation (CHLPI) is a clinical teaching program of Harvard Law School, addressing health disparities with legal solutions.

feeds.title: Stayin' Alive
feeds.description: Discussion of public health and health care policy, from a public health perspective. The U.S. spends more on medical services than any other country, but we get less for it. Major reasons include lack of universal access, unequal treatment, and underinvestment in public health and social welfare. We will critically examine the economics, politics and sociology of health and illness in the U.S. and the world.

feeds.title: The Health Policy Partnership Blog
feeds.description: Health Policy Partnership is a specialist health policy research organisation working to resolve complex issues facing healthcare systems. Find out what's happening at HPP, including project launches, events and blog posts from our team.

feeds.title: KHN
feeds.description: Kaiser Health News (KHN.org) is a nonprofit news service covering health policy issues. Our stories appear in media outlets nationwide.

feeds.title: KFF
feeds.description: The Kaiser Family Foundation website provides in-depth information on key health policy issues including Medicaid, Medicare, health reform, global health, HIV/AIDS, health insurance, the uninsured and much more.

feeds.title: Public Consulting Group
feeds.description: Founded in 1986 and headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, PCG helps public sector health, education, and human services organizations make measurable improvements to their performance and processes. PCG's Health Policy News Blog is written by some of PCG's most knowledgeable and experienced health policy subject matter experts. With this blog, they aim to distill the latest federal and state health policy news into relevant and digestible reading.

feeds.title: The Medical Care Blog » Health policy
feeds.description: The official blog of the peer-reviewed journal Medical Care, sponsored by the Medical Care Section of the American Public Health Association

feeds.title: Jon Rappoport
feeds.description: The Hottest Takes on Culture and Health Politics

feeds.title: Managed Care Matters
feeds.description: Joseph Paduda's weblog on managed care for group health, workers compensation & auto insurance, covering health care cost containment, health policy, health research, and medical news for insurers, employers, and healthcare providers.

feeds.title: Get Ready
feeds.description: The Blog is run by the American Public Health Association. The blog has been active since 2006, and it currently sees 1-2 new posts a week. The topics on the blog range greatly, from seasonal health tips to important health policy releases. Primarily, the Blog is designed to prepare people for infectious diseases and help them avoid health issues in the future.

feeds.title: Kentucky Health Policy Institute Blog
feeds.description: Kentucky Health Policy Institute, Inc. in 2005 is a vehicle for some of the writing and research. It is a nonprofit corporation registered in the Commonwealth of Kentucky.

feeds.title: Health Care Policy and Marketplace Review
feeds.description: Bob Laszewski's review of the latest developments in federal health policy, health care reform, and marketplace activities in the health care financing business.

feeds.title: Healthcare Economist
feeds.description: Jason's research interests include all issues related to healthcare policy and economics, value-based purchasing, the health insurance market, and Medicare policy research.

feeds.title: Public Health Today Blog
feeds.description: Public health promotes and protects the health of people and the communities where they live, learn, work and play. As an affiliate of American Association of Public Health (APHA), we are a membership organization that works to improve the level of health and well-being for all Arizonans through advocacy, professional development and networking. Since 1928 we have been providing services to a wide range of members in the public health sector including health care professionals, state and county health employees, heath educators, community advocates, doctors, nurses, students and faculty.

feeds.title: Health Business Group Blog
feeds.description: Health care business consultant and policy expert David E. Williams shares his views. Make the most of your healthcare business' strategies through pointed, updated consulting services. Let us help with analysis, insight, and action.
